text_block_list.text: (Ruuuumble...!!)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I'll win...! Me, me, ME!!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor A
text_block_list.text:
LIKE・I'D・LET・YOOOOUUUU!!
HAAAAAHHHHHHHH—!!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor B
text_block_list.text:
I won't give it up!!
Under nooooo circumstances will I yield!!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor C
text_block_list.text:
Out of my way!!
Daaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The queen is... ME!!
(Waaaaaaahhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohhhhh...!? Isn't...
Isn't her intensity insane this time around?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah...! How should I put it, it goes way beyond just cuteness or elegance—

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: That wildness, or something like it—!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Sweep...!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fuhaaah!! Haa, haa, haa--

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(............What was that just now?
What was that, what was that, what was that—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Somehow—that was super fun...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
"Man, for real, that 'Oaks' was so hype!!
At this rate—"

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't this just make you look forward to next week's
Japan Derby even more?!
It's like our whole generation is fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! A dream-filled race to decide the protagonist of such a heated Classic generation...! I-I can't wait~!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: —Honestly, I never even thought about it until I saw your interview.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that is kind of infuriating!!
Why can't the Oaks be the race that decides the star of our generation?!

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor A
text_block_list.text:
Right? Like... are they treating us
like an opening act for the Triple Crown route? ...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor B
text_block_list.text:
"The Triple Tiara is a supreme honor as well.
I won't let anyone look down on it."

text_block_list.name: Oaks Competitor C
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps we should take a cue from a certain magical girl,
and allow ourselves to be just a little bit more
'selfish'.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Aha. ...Right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This is so boring, honestly!

And then, after the concert had ended,
just as we were about to head home—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san. Thank you for your hard work today...
It was a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh? If it isn't Rob Roy!
You were here the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was watching your run intently
from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh? ...So, how was it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ......Precisely,

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought... yes, it truly felt
like 'pure magic.'

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just watching made my heart leap—
An excitement filled my chest,
as if the world was being repainted with every single stride.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I was thrilled.
My heart was racing.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I want to, too," was what I thought.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...You too?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes... That is correct, Sweep.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it... from the very beginning,
you were like a blazing comet.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
She appeared out of nowhere with such gallantry,
proudly declaring a dream
that almost sounded like a fairy tale.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
To me... to someone who was always shrinking back,
you looked so dazzlingly bright.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Surely.
...I believe it was admiration.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
And today you... no,
today you looked more radiantly shining than ever.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You were so dazzling! And that's what made me remember...
...That I wanted to become just like you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy, you—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "I couldn't get the results I wanted in the Classic Year. But... still!"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Geez, I won't use that as an excuse to feel ashamed
and keep my mouth shut anymore!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Because I'm the Umamusume who's going to become a hero!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Ms. Sweep.
Your magic gave me courage.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Thank you—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (...Found you.)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(Found one here, too.
Someone who fell under my magic—!)

Zenno Rob Roy gave a deep bow and departed.
After watching her back until she was out of sight,
Sweep Tosho—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Familiar.
Let's start preparing for the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
—We're not wrong.
The magic of racing lies just beyond this point!!
